proposed.explanation: Order has profound functional and experiential consequences. Clear ordering often enables creativity rather than constraining it; complexity requires coherent organization. Ordering systems structure both form and space together. Order is structural, not decorative. Without order, buildings become chaotic and confusing. Grids, hierarchies, and symmetries allow occupants to intuitively understand spatial organization and facilitate wayfinding, while creating visual coherence.
